description: This file is a PHP script designed for loading and populating database tables related to recruitment candidates, job titles, and vacancies in an OrangeHRM-like system. It includes database connection setup, data insertion functions, table truncation, and data population with sample data for testing or initial setup purposes.

methods.name: display
methods.description: A placeholder function for debugging or logging output; currently commented out.

methods.name: checkQueryResult
methods.description: Checks the result of a mysqli query; if not successful, outputs the error and performs a rollback.

methods.name: truncateTables
methods.description: Truncates specific recruitment-related tables to reset data.

methods.name: addJobTitles
methods.description: Inserts predefined job titles into the database and updates the last ID.

methods.name: addJobVacancies
methods.description: Inserts predefined job vacancy entries with descriptions read from external text files and updates the last ID.

methods.name: addCandidates
methods.description: Populates candidate data, including personal info, CVs, vacancy applications, and history, generating sample entries based on a limit.

methods.name: getCandidateQPartial
methods.description: Generates a partial SQL VALUES string for inserting candidate basic info.

methods.name: getCvQPartial
methods.description: Generates a partial SQL VALUES string for inserting candidate CV data.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyQPartial
methods.description: Generates a partial SQL VALUES string for candidate vacancy assignments.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryQPartial
methods.description: Generates a partial SQL VALUES string for candidate history entries.
